headerDisplay: Xiaomi miio devices over the LAN, without the Xiaomi cloud. Supported models: `zhimi.fan.za1`, `dmaker.fan.p33`. The model is detected from the device.

night.title: Night
night.description: When the night values of the devices below are used. Leave empty to never use them.

start.title: Start
start.description: Local time of the Homebridge host, HH:MM.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name the accessory is added with.

address.title: IP address
address.description: Give the device a fixed address on the router. The accessory is tied to this address.

token.title: Token
token.description: The 32 hex character miio token of the device.

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often the state is read, to pick up what was changed at the device or in the Mi Home app.

moveSwitches.title: Move Left and Move Right switches
moveSwitches.description: Two switches that turn the head of a fan step by step while they are on.

buzzer.title: Buzzer
buzzer.description: on or off: the plugin keeps the device at that value. unmanaged: left alone.

buzzerAtNight.title: Buzzer at night
buzzerAtNight.description: same: the value above. With an unmanaged value above, the device gets back what it had before the night.
